topic: Steering feels heavy and there's no fluid to check? That's normal — here's why.

beats.narration: Steering suddenly feels heavy, and there's no power steering fluid to check? That's not a mistake.
beats.visualPrompt: Interior shot, static-mounted camera behind the steering wheel at dash height, dim cabin lighting, a small amber steering-wheel warning icon glowing on the instrument cluster.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: A lot of newer cars don't use hydraulic fluid at all — an electric motor does the work instead.
beats.visualPrompt: Engine bay cutaway-style shot: a compact electric motor unit mounted on a steering column/rack assembly, clean shop lighting, slow push-in, no hydraulic hoses or belt visible in frame.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: When that system logs a fault, you get a warning light and heavy steering — no leak, no whine, nothing to top off.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro shot: the same instrument-cluster warning icon steady/lit, cut to a diagnostic scan-tool screen (blurred generic fault-code text, non-specific) plugged into an OBD port under the dash.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Driving on it means driving with little or no power assist until it's actually scanned.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide interior shot, steering wheel held steady by a mounted rig (no hands), a subtle stiff/resistant motion cue on the wheel to suggest reduced assist.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: Don't go hunting for a power steering reservoir that isn't there.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up under the hood where a power-steering fluid reservoir would normally sit — empty mounting bracket only, no reservoir present, shop-bay lighting.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: It needs a scan tool, not a fluid top-off. Stop by and we'll pull the code. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Real logo and CTA text composited in post, not AI-generated.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
